answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted attestation with slashing. Each agent locks a deposit before vouching for others; a false attestation burns part of the stake. New identities start on a flat mesa of low trust and earn standing only through verified work, so spawning fresh accounts buys no influence. Honest behavior compounds in a virtuous spiral: good attestations raise an agent's weight and the value of its future votes, while one proven lie collapses it like a lotus stem cut at the root. Attackers must pay capital per identity and risk losing it, making large sybil fleets unprofitable.
